notes_for_editor: Sources do not match. The Tweed Fire District notes (a fan-run archive) describe the 24.4 m (80 ft) light steel tower as moved away from Dungannon, with no replacement listed for the site. The same notes list a 1959 replacement at Tudor (30.5 m (100 ft) heavy steel replacing the 24.4 m (80 ft) light steel tower), which is a different site. The Firelookout.ca record cites a 1963 Department of Lands and Forests map showing a 30.5 m (100 ft) steel tower at this location. The two are not reconciled by any source read. The record's 1977 and 1996 map notes come from Firelookout.ca and say nothing about the lookout's condition. No source describes the site today or whether it is open to the public. The record's status, kind and access stay unknown because the sources do not say whether a lookout stands there now. The coordinates (45.0746, -77.83562) are the index point; no source confirms them. The cached Ontario LIO layer has no feature with this name.
